title: MXP London Startup Hackathon & Masterclass: Build Prototypes and Master Product Strategy in One Day (May 19)
summary: 🇬🇧 If you're based in London, this one's for you! MXP London: Startup Hackathon & Masterclass 📅 Tuesday, 19 May |📍Mixpanel London HQ, The Dock @ TIDE Bankside | 🆓 Free to attend We're hosting a one-day, product experience in partnership with ProductX and Replit, and there are still a handful of spots left. This isn't your typical hackathon. You'll go from strategy to working prototype in a single day, all built around one question: how do you make better product decisions when AI has changed how fast everyone can build? Here's how the day breaks down 👇 🧠 Morning masterclass with ProductX: a live session on Product Strategy in the AI Era. Why traditional prioritization frameworks are breaking down, and what a sharper decision-making framework actually looks like in practice. 💡 Hackathon sessions: work in small teams to define a problem, design a solution, and build a working prototype. The challenge prompt is revealed on the day, so no idea or team needed beforehand! 🔍 Expert product analysis: after presentations, a panel of experts will breakdown each team's solution, connecting the product choices back to real business outcomes. The stakes 🏆 • Winning team is announced during the MXP London main conference keynote on 21 May and takes home a cash prize • Every participant gets a free month of Replit Core Spots are limited to keep it tight and collaborative. If you're a founder, PM, or growth lead in London, come spend a Tuesday with us. 👉 Apply here: https://events.mixpanel.com/hackathon-london-2026/
